title: Dark-web-exposed card spent on cash-equivalent merchants
hypothesis: A card whose number was sold is used to buy what turns into cash. Flag money transfers of at least $100 on a card flagged as seen on the dark web.
scenario_assumptions: card_on_dark_web = 1 marks an exposed card; the schema lists only 0.
clause: transactions.amount_usd_cents >= 10000 AND transactions.card_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM cards c WHERE c.card_on_dark_web = 1) AND transactions.merchant_id IN (SELECT m.id FROM merchants m WHERE m.mcc IN (4829, 6011, 6051)) AND transactions.transaction_type IN ('Online Transaction', 'Swipe Transaction', 'Chip Transaction')
rule_assumptions: An exposed card is one with card_on_dark_web = 1.

caveats.message: 0 of the 0 flagged transactions have a fraud label. Precision and recall use those only.
The rule flags no transactions. Check the spelling and case of the values in the clause: text comparisons are case-sensitive ('Debit', not 'debit').

criteria.detail: Lift above 1.5 times the period's base fraud rate: undefined (nothing flagged is labelled).
Lift above 1 times the period's base fraud rate: undefined (nothing flagged is labelled).
Lift at least 50% of the discovery period's: cannot be compared.

backtest_sql:
WITH flagged AS (
  SELECT id, amount_usd_cents FROM transactions WHERE (
transactions.amount_usd_cents >= 10000 AND transactions.card_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM cards c WHERE c.card_on_dark_web = 1) AND transactions.merchant_id IN (SELECT m.id FROM merchants m WHERE m.mcc IN (4829, 6011, 6051)) AND transactions.transaction_type IN ('Online Transaction', 'Swipe Transaction', 'Chip Transaction')
  )
)
SELECT
  count(flagged.id) AS flagged,
  count(f.is_fraud) AS flagged_labelled,
  coalesce(sum(f.is_fraud = 1), 0) AS true_positives,
  coalesce(sum(f.is_fraud = 0), 0) AS false_positives,
  coalesce(sum(flagged.amount_usd_cents), 0) AS flagged_amount_cents,
  coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN f.is_fraud = 1 THEN flagged.amount_usd_cents END), 0)
    AS fraud_amount_caught_cents,
  coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN f.is_fraud = 0 THEN flagged.amount_usd_cents END), 0)
    AS false_positive_amount_cents,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM transactions) AS total_transactions,
  (SELECT count(is_fraud) FROM fraud_labels) AS total_labelled,
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(is_fraud = 1), 0) FROM fraud_labels) AS total_fraud
FROM flagged
LEFT JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(flagged.id AS TEXT)
monthly_sql:
WITH flagged AS (
  SELECT id FROM transactions WHERE (
transactions.amount_usd_cents >= 10000 AND transactions.card_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM cards c WHERE c.card_on_dark_web = 1) AND transactions.merchant_id IN (SELECT m.id FROM merchants m WHERE m.mcc IN (4829, 6011, 6051)) AND transactions.transaction_type IN ('Online Transaction', 'Swipe Transaction', 'Chip Transaction')
  )
)
SELECT
  coalesce(substr(t.date, 1, 7), '') AS month,
  count(flagged.id) AS flagged,
  count(CASE WHEN flagged.id IS NOT NULL THEN f.is_fraud END) AS flagged_labelled,
  coalesce(sum(flagged.id IS NOT NULL AND f.is_fraud = 1), 0) AS true_positives,
  coalesce(sum(flagged.id IS NOT NULL AND f.is_fraud = 0), 0) AS false_positives,
  coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN flagged.id IS NOT NULL THEN t.amount_usd_cents END), 0)
    AS flagged_amount_cents,
  coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN flagged.id IS NOT NULL AND f.is_fraud = 1 THEN t.amount_usd_cents END), 0)
    AS fraud_amount_caught_cents,
  coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN flagged.id IS NOT NULL AND f.is_fraud = 0 THEN t.amount_usd_cents END), 0)
    AS false_positive_amount_cents,
  count(*) AS total_transactions,
  count(f.is_fraud) AS total_labelled,
  coalesce(sum(f.is_fraud = 1), 0) AS total_fraud
FROM transactions t
LEFT JOIN flagged ON flagged.id = t.id
LEFT JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
verdict: No signal: this rule flagged 0 of 3,520 transactions, so there was nothing to measure. The likely reason: no row of cards has card_on_dark_web = 1. The schema lists only the value 0 for that column.
